The Breit--Wigner transmission through a level at $\epsilon_0$ with width $\Gamma>0$ is
\begin{equation}
T(E) = \frac{\Gamma^2}{(E-\epsilon_0)^2+\Gamma^2} .
\label{eq:bw}
\end{equation}
It is even in energy,
\begin{equation}
T(\omega) = T(-\omega) .
\label{eq:even}
\end{equation}
